items.title: Email · recruiter · Jordan Okafor
items.subject: Summer 2027 software internship question
items.body:
Hi Jordan,

I'm a computer engineering student at the University of Northfield. Last summer at Harbourview Labs I built a Python service that cut report generation from 40 minutes to 6 minutes. Could you tell me which teams take Summer 2027 interns?

Thanks,
Sam
items.angle: Leads with the report-generation project, which is closest to the backend work in this posting.
